_comment: Module registry — the editorial source of truth for the docs substrate. This is the ONE thing the generators cannot derive from code: the audience classification (user_facing -> gets a T1 public/ page; infra -> T2-only), a display title, and a one-line scope. The substrate generator asserts this is 1:1 with the real modules: every src/features/* has an entry with code:true, the two backend-mirrored concepts (activity, metadata) have code:false (docs only, no reference.md), and every entry has an internal README. public_slug defaults to the module name; bankAccounts uses the kebab public page bank-accounts.md.

account.title: Account
account.scope: the /account/* profile, security, privacy and settings area

auth.title: Auth
auth.scope: sign-in, 2FA, recovery, and the device-bound token machinery

bankAccounts.title: Bank accounts
bankAccounts.scope: your accounts + the savings account, with UPI/QR input

beneficiaries.title: Beneficiaries
beneficiaries.scope: the merchants and people you pay

budgets.title: Budgets
budgets.scope: spending limits and the expense tracker

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.scope: the authenticated home — a glance over every feature

onboarding.title: Onboarding
onboarding.scope: the guided setup, sample-data demo, and product tour

payments.title: Payments
payments.scope: the UPI initiate-and-record rail — payload, handoff, confirm-on-return

tags.title: Tags
tags.scope: the category tree that sets each transaction's tax treatment

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.scope: the ledger, manual entry and statement upload

settings.title: Settings
settings.scope: the /settings/* shell that mounts other features' pages

users.title: Users
users.scope: the current-user data layer (no pages of its own)

activity.title: Activity
activity.scope: the signal feed and notification bell

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.scope: read-only reference data, now living in shared/

_handbook_comment: Handbook + structure docs — the OTHER generated index (internal/README.md + internal/handbook/README.md). Coverage-asserted 1:1 with the docs on disk, same as modules. 'domain'/'governs' feed the handbook table; 'summary' feeds the structure list; order is editorial (as written here).

engineering.governs: how a feature is built in code — the presentational view seam, module boundaries, week, API contract

interaction.governs: the shared UI surfaces and how they behave — modals, searchable lists, banners, row highlight

design-system.governs: the visual & motion _design language_ — tokens, the two-beat model, chips, enum labels, QR

testing.governs: the test setup (Vitest + MSW) and how to test a feature

documentation.governs: the docs system itself — the tiers, the generate→inject→fold pipeline, and how to add a feature or doc

architecture.summary: the design: the module shape, the routing / data-fetching / state models, and the cross-cutting contracts

core.summary: the `src/app/` composition root: the provider stack, the router mount, the root layout, the landing pages

shared.summary: the `src/shared/` primitives catalog: nav, modals, charts, the motion foundation, layout shells, theme, error boundaries

performance.summary: the bundle budgets, the warm-cost model, the background-warming gate, and the perf/size CI gates
